title: CogniShiftGoldQAAnnotation
description: Schema for human-verified gold-standard question-answering evaluation pairs across NASA and CSB technical documents.

question_id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark QA item (e.g. NASA-001, CSB-014).

question.description: The exact natural language question evaluated against the RAG retrieval and inference engine.

normalized_answer.description: The canonical, normalized ground-truth answer string used for exact or semantic comparison.

accepted_answers.description: Permissible lexical variants, synonyms, or alternative formulations of the correct answer.

document_id.description: Identifier of the source document in the benchmark corpus (e.g. NTRS-20150004079, CSB-2022-BP-Husky).

relevant_pages.description: 1-indexed page numbers containing the exact facts required to formulate the correct answer.

supporting_excerpt_reference.description: Direct textual quotation from the relevant page(s) justifying the ground-truth answer.

question_type.description: Cognitive and structural category of the technical question.

difficulty.description: Assessed complexity level of finding and synthesizing the answer.

split.description: Evaluation split assignment (20% dev for inspection, 80% eval strictly frozen for testing).

verification_status.description: Audit state of the ground truth. Only 'human_verified' items are ingested into the evaluation split.

verified_by.description: Identifier of the human operator who audited the document citation and verified correctness.

verification_timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp when human verification was performed.
